gpu_tip: ~57GB total at 128K context, ~18GB of it KV cache since every one of the 64 layers uses full attention. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4080) plus a 48GB DDR5 kit covers it, with llama.cpp's layer offloading running the remaining layers from RAM.
mac_tip: Needs ~57GB — fits a 64GB MacBook Pro (M4 Pro/Max or M5 Pro/Max), with little room for much else alongside.
